reference.capture: fresh no-config/no-provider cases re-running the bounded delayed /help Setup Required action probe

normalization: Reference checkout, synthetic HOME/HERMES_HOME paths, PTY paths, session identifiers, timestamps, config values, credentials, and raw redraw bytes are omitted or represented by placeholders.

Each fresh case submits /help, waits for Setup Required, then probes only /model or /setup with two Enter presses; no credentials, OAuth, external network, provider value, model choice, or setup selection is entered.
The control case sends Ctrl+C once, verifies the process remains alive with Setup Required visible, then uses the bounded second press for clean exit and terminal restoration.
The observed ready-marker redraw after follow-up Enter presses is retained as an unresolved screen detail and is not interpreted as provider readiness or successful setup.
